static_contract.semantic_clock_definition: Eligibility decay is one multiplicative eligibility_decay step before each dequeued event; reward is itself a dequeued event and therefore receives the pre-reward decay step. No biological or public continuous-time eligibility-clock claim is made.

behavioral_anchor.purpose: Make reward-modulated eligibility causally consequential to a later clean prediction probe without using H5 or protected outcomes.

source_derived_not_measured_arithmetic.interpretation: These values are algebraic expectations from the bound stable-main semantics and configuration, not a synthetic result opened in this cycle.

crossover_family.graph_generator: Extend the behavioral anchor with deterministic plastic credit-cohort edges and dormant plastic distractor edges. Active cohort sources are stimulated prospectively; dormant sources are never stimulated. Remaining edges are arranged in deterministic fan-in groups so total edge count and in-degree can be varied without changing information privilege.
crossover_family.active_credit_definition: An edge is active-credit at reward iff its eligibility is nonzero under the exact reference event sequence. The designated decision edge anchors behavioral consequence; all active-cohort reward-updated weights remain part of the exact state trajectory.
crossover_family.delay_palette: Distinct positive delays are deterministic and round-robin assigned from the preregistered K-level palette; event ordering from the shared priority queue is part of semantics.
crossover_family.neutral_event_lifetime_control: Eligibility lifetime is varied by inserting a preregistered number of semantically neutral dequeued events before reward; this manipulates the current engine's event-count decay clock without changing the claim to physical-time decay.

comparators.definition: Current stable-main semantics: traverse all connections for every eligibility decay and traverse all connections on reward before guarding plastic/nonzero eligibility.
Dense/vectorized realization of the same edge-wise state transition; logical semantic primitive counts remain edge-wise and wall-clock acceleration is a separate unclaimed quantity.

Use source-indexed outgoing edges for fire-time increments plus a sparse eligibility index for reward-time work, preserving the same event-count decay and update order.

equal_semantics.invalid_comparator_rule: Any discrete mismatch or floating mismatch outside tolerance invalidates that comparator for resource interpretation; no rescue retuning of tolerance or semantics is permitted after outcomes.

primitive_operation_count.aggregation: Each listed semantic primitive counts one; totals and subcounts are retained. No wall-clock weighting is applied.

resource_vector.retained_history_timestamp_memory: Peak logical slots for active-edge IDs, eligibility scalars, decay epochs/timestamps, history records and delay buckets; byte-level allocator/runtime overhead is a separate claim.
resource_vector.history_entry_manipulation_count: Count each insert/read/update/delete/lossless-compaction of an eligibility/history/timestamp entry once.
resource_vector.delay_diversity_overhead: Report distinct live delay buckets/slots and all extra delay-bucket lookups/inserts/pops attributable to the comparator.
resource_vector.common_bookkeeping_rule: Common bookkeeping is reported separately and cannot be credited as eligibility-localization gain unless the comparator changes it while preserving identical semantics, in which case the change is disclosed separately.

scaling_crossover_grid.execution_rule: Future measurement, if separately authorized, runs the anchor, each one-factor sweep with all non-swept values fixed to anchor-compatible values, and the four named corners. No grid point may be added or removed after observing results except under a fresh successor object.

prospective_interpretation.ordinary_reduction_exhaustion_signal: At least one semantically valid ordinary comparator has strictly lower eligibility/plasticity primitive-operation count than REF_GLOBAL_SCAN at two adjacent preregistered points in any sweep using no extra outcome information. Report all memory/history/delay tradeoffs; this remains SYSTEM engineering/resource evidence only.
prospective_interpretation.tradeoff_only: Operation localization accompanied by increased retained history/timestamp memory, history manipulation or delay overhead is reported as a crossover tradeoff, not hidden or collapsed into one score.
prospective_interpretation.no_localization_on_grid: No semantically valid ordinary comparator reduces the preregistered eligibility/plasticity primitive-operation count on any grid point; this is a SYSTEM negative characterization, not a MECHANISM result.
prospective_interpretation.claim_scope: Current SparkBrain reference-engine resource localization under the bound event-count eligibility semantics. No claim about biological mechanism, cognition, broad event routing, continuous-time eligibility, H5 reinterpretation, PRE_FORMAL readiness, FORMAL evidence, wall-clock speed, cache, bandwidth or energy.
